faq_q2_a: AIHubMix covers 6 flagship models across providers: Nano Banana Pro (top-tier character consistency), Nano Banana 2 (budget-friendly speed), GPT Image 2 (text rendering), Seedream 5.0 Pro (precise editing), FLUX Kontext (localized editing), Z-Image Turbo. Alipay/WeChat accepted.
faq_q2_b: Hugging Face offers 4 public SDXL/SD open-source models. Just create a free token at huggingface.co - zero cost.
faq_q2_c: Pollinations is the value pick: $1 ≈ 1 pollen, Alipay top-up from ¥10 (best price/performance). Switch in the model dropdown.
faq_q3_intro: Both are pay-as-you-go with no subscriptions, and both support Alipay (from ~¥10).
faq_q3_a: AIHubMix: ¥0.05-2 per image. See aihubmix.com for details.
faq_q3_b: Pollinations: 0.0001-0.12 pollen/image (1 pollen ≈ $0.01). Nano Banana billed per output token; Quest models can earn pollen for free.
faq_a5_intro: Studio is the advanced editing entry, with 4 scene templates:
faq_a5_a: ① Edit: 1 image, precise instructions to change colors/add objects while preserving the rest.
faq_a5_b: ② Outfit Swap: 2 images (A = outfit, B = person). Auto-transfers the outfit.
faq_a5_c: ③ Fusion: blend 2 images into one.
faq_a5_d: ④ Background: keep the subject, replace the background.
faq_a5_recommend: Recommended: Nano Banana Pro (Google Gemini) - best multi-image editing capability.
